Workflow

Giving, restricted funds and the endowment

Gifts land in named funds held by the right entity, with restriction set only by donor designation. Funds such as the Endowed Fund are shown on the Care branch and cannot be joined.

Built in the Hub
Partly built The public giving door (J12) and ARFECF fund boundaries are built. Rows for the four contributor moments, surplus-before-payment, the purpose catalogue, Senior Living pledges and club giving (B3, gated) are not built.
Branches
Care Education
Shared services
Funds and ledger, Directory and communications
Governed by
D2 · D3 · D7 · D8 · D9 · D10 · D40 · S3 · R25

Steps

  1. Choose a cause or fund, an amount and a frequencyDonor
  2. Read the surplus and shortfall rule on the page before paying (D7)Donor
  3. Receipt a ticket as a purchase and any gift beyond it as a deductible gift, by the receiving entity (D9)Platform
  4. Authorise raising in another entity's name from a purpose catalogue; a new purpose goes to that entity's board (D8)Entity officer or board
  5. Authorise Endowment or Scholarship Fund spendingThe fund's own committee (ARFECF 6.3.4 / 6.4.4)
  6. Tell the contributor at four moments: receipt, goal reached, funds transferred, purpose fulfilled (D10)Platform

Hands off to

  • giving → ledger: gifts post gross by fund; reversals run through receivables (R20, R25, S3)
  • giving → comms: the four contributor moments, then an annual statement (D10)
  • giving → reporting: lapsed donors surface as a report that asks for a call (JF-003)

Programmes that use it

Scholarship · Medical Mission · Women to Women · Senior Living Project · Ramallah Preservation Project

Open

  • The Endowment Fund Policy Statement and the 2015 Scholarship Fund Policy Statement are not on file; the cap-versus-floor spend rule is unsettled.
  • ARFECF's exempt-status determination letter is not on file; exempt-status claims on receipts wait on it.
  • Whether clubs take gifts through the platform onto their own books (Breeze Parity §5 q3).
